remarks: Welcome to a desirable Fairfield House!!!... centrally located complex offering charm and convenience. This spacious light and bright 1BD condo comes with a dining area/living room combo that has access to an oversized corner balcony with lovely southern exposure. Kitchen and bathroom have been fully updated to meet today's modern demands. Granite countertops and SS appliances in the kitchen and beautiful large flower and stand up shower tiles with tasteful contemporary touches including updated lighting, bathroom vanity, shower head and even shower light complete this gorgeous unit. The Primary bedroom is very spacious and comes with two closets. Large storage unit and common laundry area as well as bike storage area are in the basement. Hardwood floors and recessed lights throughout. Heat and hot water are included in the common charges. Pet friendly complex. One parking spot included in the HOA. Garage parking spot is extra $60/mo. Walk to Greenwich hospital, Greenwich Ave and Downtown shops and restaurants as well as Metro North. This location cannot be beat!!! Grab it while it lasts.
